messages:
maria (Support): FYI Pellion's dedicated pool started returning spikes of 429s + intermittent auth failures around 09:12 UTC after they launched a promotional campaign. Raising here for capacity + auth check.

suresh (Account): Customer says baseline QPS ~1200, peak ~11k for 6 minutes; they expected our autoscale to cover it. Billing spike noticed too.

jay (SRE): Got logs from the pool. We're seeing queue depth increase and sustained 95% GPU util on pool-3 nodes. Some tenants show huge token/sec variance -> potential noisy neighbor.

alex (Runtime): Any model changes or new routing variants from Pellion? We need sequence length distribution + avg tokens per request to estimate headroom.

maria (Support): They sent this: "avg tokens/request 48, 95th seq len ~220, burst pattern 10s on / 20s off during campaign window". Also sample req-id: req_2026-04-11_09:13:44_7f3c.

jay (SRE): Repro quick check: pulled request traces for req_2026-04-11_09:13:44_7f3c -> saw heavy KV cache misses early in bursts, cold-starty behavior (cache churn). This amplifies per-request cost.

alex (Runtime): If KV cache miss rate high, per-token latency jumps and effective throughput falls. With their 95th seq ~220 that's expensive. Our autoscaler scales on p99 latency + queue depth with 30s cooldown; short 6-minute pulses can overshoot.

autoscale-bot: Pool autoscale event: added 4 nodes to pool-3 at 09:14:02 UTC (policy: add 2 nodes per scale). Current pool size: 10 -> 14.

jay (SRE): Despite scale, utilization stayed ~85-95% because requests are longer and batching less efficient during burst. Noisy tenant observed: tenant-17 produced large fat requests ~500 tokens each for short window.

suresh (Account): Pellion says they didn't change their model but turned on a vectorized rerank step, likely increasing tokens. They're surprised by billing jump.

maria (Support): Symptoms: 429s + 401 auth fails (transient) reported. 401s line up with throttling/backpressure on auth-service? Logs: "auth: upstream error: 503" for some requests.

jay (SRE): Auth 401s look like our auth service returned 503 to the proxy which translated to 401 for some flows. Auth service CPU spiked correlated to same window — probably unrelated but exacerbated client retries.

alex (Runtime): Immediate mitigations: 1) temporary increase pool target min nodes to 18 (suresh ok?), 2) enable short-term higher-burst autoscale policy (increase add-per-scale to 6 and shorten cooldown to 15s), 3) apply per-tenant soft-QPS limit for tenant-17 to protect neighbors.

suresh (Account): Customer asked for quick fix; approve short-term scale increase. They'll eat billing for spike.

maria (Support): I'll ask them to confirm acceptance for temporary scale and we'll notify billing.

jay (SRE): I'll run repro in staging to validate autoscale policy changes. Repro steps below.

jay (SRE): Repro steps (staging):
```
# synthetic burst generator
for i in $(seq 1 2000); do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TEST_KEY}" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-opti-3b","input":"${RANDOM_PROMPT}","max_tokens":500}' &
  if (( i % 50 == 0 )); then sleep 1; fi
done
```
Run ramp: baseline 1200 qps (10s cadence), then spike to 11k for 6 minutes. Record p50/p90/p99 latencies and KV cache hit rate.

alex (Runtime): Also capture per-tenant batch size and queue dwell time. Add metric: per-tenant token/sec and estimated token cost.

maria (Support): Customer-side repro snippet they used (curl):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-pellion-prod" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","prompt":"<campaign prompt>","max_tokens":220}'
```
They said retries were automatic so observed 429 -> immediate retry -> amplification.

jay (SRE): Action items:
- jay: implement per-tenant soft-QPS cap for tenant-17 and throttle in proxy (ETA 45m).
- alex: patch autoscale policy for pool-3 for burst window (ETA 30m, test in staging).
- maria: confirm Pellion approval for temp pool min=18 and inform billing (ETA 10m).
- suresh: coordinate customer comms and credits if needed (ETA 1h).

suresh (Account): I'll schedule postmortem call with Pellion for capacity planning and recommend targeting 60% sustained GPU util for baseline with headroom for 99th percentile peaks.

maria (Support): Noted follow-ups: schedule canary of policy change at 10:15 UTC, monitor p99 and 429 rates. If <1% 429 over 30m, rollback.

alex (Runtime): Longer-term recommendations to share with Pellion: reduce avg tokens/request where possible, enable local KV warmup for campaign flows, and consider request shaping at client side. We'll propose a reserved-burst slab for these promo windows.

jay (SRE): I'll attach traces/snippets to the support ticket and mark thread for incident tracking.

maria (Support): Thanks all. Leaving open until actions complete. :thumbsup:
